title: Unique Crunchy Ethiopian Wild Mushrooms Kik Alicha
description: A citrusy and adventurous Ethiopian dish featuring wild mushrooms, this vegan-friendly recipe is a twist on the traditional kik alicha, with a crunchy texture from blanched mushrooms. It is a hearty and flavorful meal that is perfect for lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: wild mushrooms
ingredients.notes: such as chanterelle or oyster mushrooms

instructions: Rinse the wild mushrooms and slice them into thin strips.
Blanch the mushroom strips in boiling water for 2 minutes, then immediately submerge them in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the sliced onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the berbere spice, salt, and black pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the blanched mushroom strips to the pan and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the mushrooms and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the kik alicha hot, garnished with additional lemon wedges if desired.
